title: Agenticx Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Agenticx adapter

testMode.description: Test Mode parameter to indicate test request

sspId.description: SSP ID for the publisher, used for user sync and request routing. Falls back to a default value if omitted

siteId.description: SSP Site ID for the publisher's site, used for user sync and request routing. Falls back to a default value if omitted
